note: Raw-material tiers (docs/CONTRACT.md Phase 6c slice VOC §2.2, N-VOC-3 as drafted). A block's tier is the highest tier among the raw inputs of its cheapest recipe path (fewest raw items, ties by recipe id; cooking recipes count, the fuel does not); a path stops at an item this table names. A block no recipe makes takes its own item's row, else its family's (fam:<family>), else the highest of its tags' rows. Anything this table does not reach is common. Keys: an item (minecraft:x), an item or block tag (#minecraft:x), or a generated family (fam:x). The tier is a taste call (N-VOC-3); every row says why.
